footer.tagline: Sponsor-funded conditional assistance for rainfed farming households in Indonesia.
footer.notInsurance: Sponsors pay for it. Households pay nothing to take part and file nothing to be paid.
footer.rights: Built in the open. Records on Solana are permanent and public.

hero.eyebrow: Rainfall relief, funded before the season
hero.title: The money is set aside before anyone knows how the season will go.
hero.lede: A sponsor locks funds ahead of planting. The list of recipient households is fixed before the rain is measured. Public rainfall data decides the outcome, and the payout is released without anyone filing a request.
hero.note: Farming households register through WhatsApp. They never hold tokens, never sign a transaction and never pay a fee.

fixed.title: Three things are fixed before the weather is known

funds.title: The funds
funds.body: In escrow mode the sponsor deposits the full amount into a program-controlled account before registration opens. The balance is readable by anyone.

roster.title: The recipient list
roster.body: Registrations close at a set time. The list is hashed into a single merkle root and written on chain. Nobody can be added or removed afterwards.

threshold.title: The rainfall threshold
threshold.body: The threshold comes from the 1991-2020 record for that grid cell: the 10th percentile for a full payment, the 20th for a half payment. It is stored on chain at creation.

steps.title: How a season runs
steps.lede: Five steps, each one leaving a record you can read without asking us.

create.title: The sponsor creates a campaign
create.body: Area, season window, amount per household and maximum number of households. The thresholds are computed from the public climate record and shown with 25 years of history before the sponsor commits.

enrol.title: Households register by WhatsApp
enrol.body: A farmer sends a message, shares the field location and gives an e-wallet number. The number is checked against the account holder name and stored encrypted. Nothing personal goes on chain.

lock.title: The list is locked
lock.body: Before the freeze time the system writes the recipient count and the merkle root of the list on chain. After that the list cannot change.

measure.title: Rainfall is measured
measure.body: Daily rainfall for the campaign grid cells is read from two independent public archives. Seven days after the window closes the totals are compared. If they differ by more than 25 percent, a person reviews it before anything is settled.

release.title: The payout is released
release.body: The reading goes on chain with the hash of the exact data used. The sponsor's auditor has 48 hours to dispute it. After that anyone can trigger the release, and the receipts are hashed back on chain.

verify.title: What you can check for yourself
verify.lede: Every statement on this site maps to a field in a 368-byte account on Solana. Read the account, recompute the hash, compare.

amount.title: Locked amount
amount.body: The vault balance, read from the token account the program controls.

roster.title: roster_root
roster.body: Recompute your own leaf from your phone number and salt, then verify it against the root on chain.

data.title: data_hash
data.body: Download the canonical rainfall document, hash it in your browser and compare it byte for byte.

receipts.title: receipts_root
receipts.body: After payment, each receipt is a leaf under a root written on chain.

limits.title: What this does not do
limits.lede: Written down so nobody has to guess.

items.area: The trigger is area rainfall for a 0.1 degree grid cell, not the condition of one particular field. A household can lose a harvest for reasons the rainfall total does not show, and a payout can arrive for a household whose field was fine.
items.pledge: In pledge mode the chain records the recipient list, the reading and the receipts, but not the money. Those campaigns carry a permanent label saying the funds are not locked on chain.
items.coverage: The amount is help with the next planting, not replacement of lost income. It is set by the sponsor and shown before anyone registers.
items.payment: Payment depends on the e-wallet number being correct and open. Failed transfers are shown on the campaign record and can be corrected within 14 days.

cta.title: Look at a campaign record
cta.body: Every number on the page comes from the chain or from the public climate archive. Nothing is filled in for display.

labels.pledgeDetail: This is a pledge campaign. The recipient list, the rainfall reading and the receipts are on chain. The money is not.
labels.replayDetail: This campaign reruns an archived season on devnet using real archived rainfall data. No household is paid from it.
labels.reviewDetail: The two rainfall sources disagree by more than 25 percent. Settlement waits for a person to decide.
labels.manualDetail: Transfers were made by an operator and evidence was hashed afterwards. They were not sent by a payment gateway.

summary.title: At a glance
summary.gridCells: {count, plural, one {# grid cell} other {# grid cells}} of 0.1 degrees

timeline.title: State
timeline.lede: The program moves through these states in one direction only.

rainfall.title: Rainfall against the thresholds
rainfall.empty: Rainfall for this window has not been read yet. The reading is taken seven days after the window closes, so late corrections in the archive are included.
rainfall.outcomeFull: Below the full-payment threshold. Every household in the locked list receives the full amount.
rainfall.outcomeHalf: Below the half-payment threshold but above the full one. Every household in the locked list receives half.
rainfall.outcomeNone: Above both thresholds. This campaign does not pay out this season and the funds return to the sponsor.
rainfall.chartLabel: Cumulative rainfall through the season window

onchain.title: On-chain record
onchain.lede: Rule version {version}. Field names match the account layout in the specification.
onchain.empty: The campaign account is not readable right now, so no on-chain field is shown.

reproduce.title: Recompute data_hash yourself
reproduce.body: Download the canonical rainfall document, hash it with SHA-256 in your browser and compare it with the value on chain. The check runs on your device.
reproduce.match: Match. The document you downloaded is exactly the one that was settled.
reproduce.mismatch: No match. The document does not correspond to the hash on chain.
reproduce.failed: The document could not be fetched. Nothing is claimed either way.
reproduce.unavailable: The canonical document is published when the campaign is settled.

receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.empty: Receipts appear after the funds are released and the transfers are made.

check.title: Are you on the list?
check.body: If you registered for this campaign, check your phone number and proof code against the root on chain.

OPEN.name: Open
OPEN.body: The campaign exists and registration is running. The list can still be locked again as more households register.

SETTLED.name: Settled
SETTLED.body: The rainfall reading and the hash of the data are on chain. The auditor has 48 hours to dispute it.

DISPUTED.name: Disputed
DISPUTED.body: The sponsor's auditor challenged the reading. Release is blocked until the operator and the auditor sign a new settlement together.

SETTLED_FINAL.name: Settled, final
SETTLED_FINAL.body: The operator and the auditor signed the reading together. It cannot be disputed again.

RELEASED.name: Released
RELEASED.body: The payout left the vault to the disburser and the remainder went back to the sponsor. The vault is closed.

RECEIPTED.name: Receipted
RECEIPTED.body: Every transfer is recorded and the merkle root of the receipts is on chain.

REFUNDED.name: Refunded
REFUNDED.body: No settlement arrived within 30 days of the window closing, so the whole vault went back to the sponsor.

check.title: Check a registration
check.lede: Your phone number and proof code stay in this browser long enough to compute one hash. The list root is read from the chain, so an answer that says yes cannot be faked by this site.
